name: Webstaurant Store
desc:
Remote Customer Solutions Specialist | $25.70/hr Starting | Phone, Chat, and Email, Order Support & Problem Solving
Company: WebstaurantStore (a Clark Associates company)
Industry: E-Commerce | Restaurant Equipment & Supply Customer Solutions
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 WebstaurantStore is a large online restaurant equipment and supply retailer, and this role has you helping customers navigate their orders and accounts using multiple software tools. You're not just answering simple questions, this is described as "action-oriented," meaning you're actively investigating problems, researching account details, and coming up with real solutions rather than reading from a fixed script.
You'll be switching between phone, live chat, and email throughout the day, keeping customers updated on order status, and partnering with other departments when an issue needs more than what you can solve alone. When something escalates, you're expected to use genuine de-escalation skills to protect the relationship while still working toward resolution. There's also a light sales awareness built in, part of the goal is enhancing customer loyalty and supporting business sales, not just closing tickets.
Schedule includes a 60-day training period on a slightly earlier shift (9am-5:30pm ET), transitioning to 9:30am-6pm ET afterward, plus one weekend shift per month (7:30am-4pm ET) with a corresponding weekday off that week.
assessment: Not a formal test, but the application itself functions as an early assessment: a tailored resume, a cover letter following a specific prompt, and a required writing sample demonstrating critical thinking through a complex situation. This is a real screening step, not just a formality.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: No degree required. Company states it values relevant skills, experience, and alignment with core values above formal education.
 Required Experience: Not specified by years in posting.
 Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
 Required Skills:
Proficiency with Office 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Windows navigation
Excellent verbal and written communication, conversational fluency in English required
Typing speed of 40 WPM
Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch tasks based on department needs
Critical thinking and complex problem-solving
Comfort communicating via chat, webcam, and video meetings regularly
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who genuinely enjoys investigative problem-solving over reading from a script
Participants who write well, since the application itself requires a cover letter and writing sample
Anyone comfortable with a fast-paced environment that involves frequent task-switching and multiple communication channels
People who want a strong starting wage and a company with an established local training team and mentorship structure
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who aren't comfortable writing a cover letter and completing a writing sample as part of applying
Someone who needs a fixed schedule with zero weekend requirement, one weekend shift per month is required
Anyone without qualifying home internet (75 Mbps download/10 Mbps upload minimum) and a physical mailing address, PO Boxes aren't supported since equipment ships to your home
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer solutions
Problem-solving
Multi-channel support (phone, chat, email)
Order management
De-escalation
Critical thinking
Customer experience
Cross-department collaboration
Office 365 proficiency
Remote customer service
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 This posting states its process directly. A strong application includes a well-written cover letter following the given prompt, a writing sample showing critical thinking through a complex situation, and a resume tailored specifically to this role. If selected, the interview process has three parts:
A phone interview with a phone interview specialist
A video interview with two Team Leaders
A final video interview with a Team Leader and a Manager
 Job offers always follow a face-to-face interview (via Microsoft Teams or in person).
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Walk me through a time you had to research and solve a complex customer problem using multiple tools or systems.
How do you approach writing a clear, professional response to a frustrated customer?
Describe your experience switching between different tasks or communication channels throughout a shift.
How do you handle receiving direct feedback from a Team Leader or Quality Assurance reviewer?
What does "doing the right thing" for a customer look like to you, even when it's not the easiest option?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Starting at $25.70/hr.
Shift: Full-time, remote. 60-day training: 9am-5:30pm ET, Monday-Friday. Post-training: 9:30am-6pm ET, Monday-Friday, plus one weekend shift monthly (7:30am-4pm ET) with a corresponding weekday off.
Benefits: Paid time off, medical/dental coverage including telemedicine, 401(k) match, paid parental leave based on tenure.
Equipment Provided: Yes, computer equipment is shipped to the employee's home (a physical address is required, PO Boxes not supported).
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research specific to WebstaurantStore/Clark Associates.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.
Notes: This is a genuinely strong starting wage ($25.70/hr) for a role with no degree requirement, one of the higher entry points in this database. The application process itself is more involved than most, requiring a tailored resume, cover letter, and writing sample upfront, so encourage participants to invest real time and effort into that step rather than treating it as a quick apply. Oklahoma is listed among the eligible states for this remote role. W-2 employment only, no H-1B sponsorship available.
Career Pathway: Customer Solutions Specialist → Senior Customer Solutions Specialist → Team Lead → Customer Solutions Supervisor → Customer Solutions Manager
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
